reviews.text:
Really friendly and professional, and the fact that there is a vet at the same time, I recommend the place. A perfect ten place 👍
Thank you Pepper 🙂
Very nice and knowledgeable staff! Clean and comfortable premises.
Pleasant environment and knowledgeable friendly staff. The cats loved it and so did we. I recommend it.
Great service, very nice staff!

I can’t really recommend this place for vet services. We have already taken our dog here 4 times: 1 actual visit and 3 follow-ups. Every time we went there, they asked us to come back for another follow-up. I feel like part of my salary is paid to Kuonola since June. It shouldn’t be this hard to diagnose. Of course, the follow-up visits also cost money. At some point, I started thinking they only do these follow-ups for money, not because they really care about pet health.
Nice staff + every sixth cut is free with a nail pass 👌
Warm and calm attitude, and skilled as a veterinarian

They were unable to trim/wash or cut my dog's fur. Previously visited Kuonola about 3 years ago - good result. Successfully trimmed elsewhere for 4 years 3-4 times a year. Now it was badly left unfinished. Ugly mark, paws and head not taken care of. I would say lack of experience. My dog ​​is nervous and can be difficult but 10 succeed - one does not. However, they charged full price?? Not very customer friendly...
The best veterinarian in Helsinki, yet the prices are kept very reasonable.
Quite a good experience, but communication could be improved. The picture was a bit unclear about pricing and other things.
We went to the vet with Tessa for an ear infection. Friendly service and good overall care for the dog.
Very friendly and professional service. We have been here before and will come again. Our 6 month old really liked the new Lagotto hairstyle :)
Nice employees and good service

We have taken our rescue dog to Kuonola a few times. He absolutely hates bathing and doesn’t cooperate much, but our groomer Virginia was patient and very accommodating with him. We will be coming back! 🐶✨ …
The staff is great😊 …
The Border Terrier's first grooming at Hertsikan Kuonola went beyond expectations. Final result 10+ Friendly service.
We received fast, professional and wonderful service for our vet-fearing kitty! Thank you ❤️

Our 11-year-old rescue has always been afraid of nail trimming and has had many challenges with it over the years and towards the end of the year it started to feel like we were going backwards with it again so we decided to try something new. We have been going to the Kuonola Herttoniemi point for several months now and I have only good things to say, the dog is still very nervous but when the staff has such a friendly attitude and professionalism you can trust that they will do it and there have been no problems. However, such a big, albeit short part of everyday life it feels like a burden has been lifted from our shoulders! Years ago we had a pretty difficult period when nail trimming was only possible under anesthesia so it is wonderful to be at this point. :)
Great staff and good service, I would love to come here with my dog ​​to Herttoniemi Künolala.
Great experience! First vaccination for the puppy. We set off with a puppy start.
Lovely warm staff, we had to take our beloved cat on her last journey. Everything went so smoothly, thank you - thank you very much.
Wonderful groomer!
Absolutely wonderful service and a knowledgeable veterinarian.
I was a little nervous about changing vets, but here is a super wonderful vet!

I've been here twice with my dog, first for a grooming and the second time for nail clipping. Both times the staff was really nice and the service was great! I can recommend it and we will continue to come here with our dog ☺️
A really positive surprise in terms of both price and service.
Very friendly service and meticulous grooming! Our dog also seemed to be best friends with virginie afterwards 💎 …
Very knowledgeable and friendly service, skilled workers. The premises are cozy and the interior pictures on the walls look like something out of a fairy tale.
The dog got a nice hair cut and seems happy
Nice
I was not satisfied. The trim was done poorly and took too long.

I'm regular visitor, and always receive great service from Virginie and Geraldine. Our dog hates getting bathed and tries to run away, but they Virginie and Geraldine always handle him with great care and professionalism. 10/10 would recommend!
Great and professional service. Maybe a little more wallet-friendly additional products😬 should be on sale …

I am very disappointed with my recent service experience. I tried to reach them by phone 21 hours before the appointment, but I did not receive a response. I also wrote to customer service to request a postponement of the grooming appointment due to my sick dog, but I did not receive any response, neither by phone nor by email. Even though I had clarified the situation and requested a postponement of the grooming, 4 days later I received the full bill for the grooming.

I kindly tried to inquire about the possibility of transferring the almost one hundred euros bill to a future grooming, as we would like to bring our dog as soon as he is in better condition. Unfortunately, the company only responded by mentioning the delay of the 24-hour cancellation period by a few hours. I would like to clarify that the delay was due to my dog ​​being sick at home, which is why we were at the doctor's. I am disappointed that my email was not answered.

It is sad to see that Kuonola seems to be solely focused on making money these days, even though their website claims to focus primarily on the well-being of their customers' dogs.

We cannot recommend this place to other dog owners, as we are not satisfied with the service we received. Your customer service and customer orientation leave a lot to be desired. I hope you reconsider your actions and invest more in customer service and customer orientation in the future.
